name: Soraya Berjaya Indonesia Tbk.
summary: PT Soraya Berjaya Indonesia Tbk, an Indonesian firm, focuses on delivering comprehensive bedroom furnishing solutions. Operating under its "Soraya Bed Sheet" brand, the company supplies a range of items such as duvet covers, fitted sheets, decorative pillows, cylindrical cushions, and various home embellishments. These products are made available to consumers through both its physical retail outlets and its digital platform. Established in 2001, the enterprise maintains its primary office in Padang, Indonesia.
